criteria.text: Replace/remove disabled live Managed skills switch and add an accessible All skills, Selected skills, No skills policy with exact null/list/[] and future-skill semantics.
Policy transitions preserve current effective access and never conflate null with [].
Selected mode supports searchable grouped choices, displayed-only bulk actions, unknown saved names, and stable deduped serialization.
Summary, catalog-error preservation, and refresh behavior retain the draft and usable policy controls.
Saving sends only changed allowedSkillsJson, reads canonical state, preserves null/[]/list, retains failures, and uses the dirty guard.
Add skill opens an accessible managed-skill editor with create-only validated slug, optional description, required instructions, and global-scope explanation.
Create uses skills.create, refreshes catalog, auto-selects only in Selected mode, retains failures, and never implicitly saves the profile.
Managed rows support content-fetching Edit/update while org/external rows remain read-only.
Delete confirms named global scope, removes successful deletion from only the current explicit draft, and retains failures.
Async results are fenced, profile switch closes dialogs, mutations disable relevant controls, and double submit is prevented.
Skill content/API errors use sanitized SkillGatewayError handling and server managed status is authoritative.
Controls and dialogs are keyboard accessible, 44px, responsive at 720px/200%, no-overflow, and axe-clean.
Canonical Playwright fixture covers exact policy transitions, PATCH/readback, shown-only bulk, unknown skill, errors, dirty guard, and all modes.
Playwright covers managed skill CRUD, stale fencing/double submit, external read-only rows, and durable screenshots.
A gated live E2E drives the actual sandbox API and engine through managed skill create/read/update/delete plus disposable profile allowlist projection and cleanup.
Run web build/dist, profile and neighboring gateway tests, API tests, live E2E, diff checks, and later UI review.
